answers.description: Independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked here each morning. Dogs, prams and muddy boots all welcome.

brand.name: Bramble and Bean
brand.tagline: An independent café on the canal in Hebden Bridge, open each morning

hero.headline: Your independent café by the canal
hero.subhead: Breakfasts, sourdough toasties and cakes baked each morning, for locals and visitors wanting a relaxed canalside café.
hero.reassurance: No need to book, just follow the towpath and find our door.

features.title: Breakfasts, toasties and cakes, made each morning
features.lead: Simple food done well, served by the water in Hebden Bridge.

items.title: Baked here each morning
items.body: Our cakes are baked fresh on site every morning. Come and see what's just come out of the oven today.

items.title: Hearty breakfasts
items.body: Start your day with a proper breakfast by the water. Simple, satisfying food cooked with care.

items.title: Sourdough toasties
items.body: Our sourdough toasties are made to order using good bread and simple fillings. A canalside favourite.

steps.title: Finding us and settling in is easy
steps.lead: Here's what to expect when you visit us on the canal.

items.title: Find us by the canal
items.body: We're easy to spot on the canal in Hebden Bridge. Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.

items.title: Settle in
items.body: Bring the dog, the pram or your muddy boots. Grab a table and take a moment by the water.

items.title: Order at the counter
items.body: Choose from breakfasts, toasties and cakes baked that morning. We'll bring it over when it's ready.

copy.statement: We wanted a café on the canal where everyone feels welcome, muddy boots, dogs and prams included.

cta.headline: Come and find us on the canal
cta.body: Drop by for breakfast, a toastie or a slice of cake baked this morning. Everyone is welcome.
cta.reassurance: Just follow the towpath and look out for our door.
